**Root: loan-event cancellation** (loan-event schedule: event reported on the day it takes effect, on the certificate most recently issued — the new certificate, processed today). Term 2026-07-20..2027-07-20 = 365 days; in force 85 days; to expiration 280 days.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the cancellation": the only certificate on the loan (LC5097721) already carries a cancellation entry, so there is nothing in force to cancel and the computation doc's step 2 gives zero; the blockquoted sentence makes the credit wait on a certificate issued on/after 2026-08-05 -> excluded.
- Cancelling LC5236617 (the most recently issued certificate before placement): wrong loan; excluded by the caller's loan number and the tool's loan_number/certificate binding.
- Base pro rata credit: excluded by the loan-event schedule scope (reported on the day, most recently issued certificate).
- GPF payment 2025-03-02 (4,020.00) outside the 12-month window -> 11,140 not 15,160 -> 0.96 not 0.92.
